options.text: Repeat cytology + selected mapping biopsies/ureteroscopy/enhanced cystoscopy

options.label: Radical cystectomy alone

options.label: Consolidative cystectomy or chemoradiation
options.text: If major response and technically feasible.

post_high.label: High-risk post-cystectomy bladder cancer: adjuvant therapy depends on neoadjuvant exposure and ctDNA-MRD.

recommendation.title: High-risk post-cystectomy bladder cancer: adjuvant therapy depends on neoadjuvant exposure and ctDNA-MRD.

options.label: Adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy
options.text: If no prior neoadjuvant platinum and eligible.

options.text: Preferred/category 1 in source-defined high-risk post-cystectomy settings.

options.label: Adjuvant atezolizumab
options.text: For ctDNA-MRD positive within source-defined post-cystectomy window and no prior ICI.

post_follow.label: Post-cystectomy lower-risk state: surveillance per BL-E.

recommendation.title: Post-cystectomy lower-risk state: surveillance per BL-E.

options.label: Platinum rechallenge
options.text: If >12 months progression-free after platinum and still eligible.

recommendation.title: Mucosal/ductal-acinar prostatic urethral urothelial carcinoma without stromal invasion: TURP + BCG or cystoprostatectomy according to extent/response.

options.label: Consider adjuvant chemotherapy if no neoadjuvant therapy
options.text: Consider adjuvant chemotherapy if no neoadjuvant therapy

options.text: Distal urethrectomy depending on tumor location

recommendation.title: Low-risk UTUC

options.text: Preferred when clinically feasible for distal ureter high-grade disease; source-defined selected ureter pathway.

consistency_rules.message: Current distant metastatic disease must supersede an isolated NMIBC initial-treatment state.
CIS cannot be treated as source low-risk NMIBC; reconcile risk assignment.
High-grade disease conflicts with low-risk NMIBC assignment.
BCG-unresponsive state requires adequate BCG exposure per BL-F definition; reconcile BCG course history.
